objective: A frozen exact census under identity at radius 2 of the 1,024 Life-like one-bit laws and the atom: each law refuted by a board from a frozen list (the one-place board, every abelian board with at most 8 places, every non-abelian board with at most 6, the 16 plane-like non-abelian boards with 7, 150 random non-abelian boards of 8 to 32 places, every thick torus of index 9 to 64), or decided by an exact view-board search (any board, a non-abelian board, a thick board), or undecided above 3,000 allowed views; for a forcing law, the two-dimensional tori of index at most 32 it allows. Prediction R1: no law forces; R2: a drawn control forces exactly its torus.
title: Which one-bit laws force a two-dimensional torus
